title: FlexLine Payments, Minimum Payment and Fee Rules
content:
This is the servicing basis for payments and fees on FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit.

## Clauses in force

1. Payments are accepted on a line in active, frozen, repayment or charged-off status, as Larkspur's record of that line shows when the payment is made.
2. Each payment is applied to billed interest, then fees, then the remaining balance.
3. During the draw period the minimum payment is the tier's minimum payment percent of the statement balance, but not less than the tier's floor (or the whole balance if smaller), plus any amount past due.
4. A late fee may be assessed only when the current date is later than the payment due date plus the late-fee grace period. The grace period is counted in calendar days starting the day after the payment due date. The due date is the line's payment due date as Larkspur's record of the line shows it.
5. A returned payment is reversed in full.
6. Balances and the minimum payment are refreshed after every line.

## Clauses no longer in force

The following clauses are **no longer in force**; they are superseded by the current basis:

> In repayment it is the level repayment payment plus any amount past due.

> The late fee is the tier's late fee for a minimum payment not paid in full, at most one per due date and never more than that minimum payment.

> A returned-payment fee of the tier's returned-payment fee, never more than the minimum payment due, is charged once per returned payment whose return code is in the tier's fee-bearing return codes.

## The late-fee grace boundary

The comparison is strictly "later than": the last grace day itself does not qualify. In abstract form, for a due date on day D and the tier's 10-day grace period:

| Current date | Later than D plus 10 days? | Late fee may be assessed |
|---|---|---|
| D plus 10 days (the last grace day) | No | No |
| D plus 11 days | Yes | Yes |

## Draw-period minimum payment (hypothetical inputs)

| Tier and statement balance | Percent of balance | Floor | Minimum payment (nothing past due) |
|---|---|---|---|
| FlexLine Standard, 1500.00 USD | 3.0% gives 45.00 | 35.00 | 45.00 USD |
| FlexLine Standard, 600.00 USD | 3.0% gives 18.00 | 35.00 | 35.00 USD |
| FlexLine Standard, 22.00 USD | 3.0% gives 0.66 | 35.00, above the balance | 22.00 USD (the whole balance) |

Where an amount is past due, it is added to the figure in the last column.

superseded_clauses: in repayment it is the level repayment payment plus any amount past due.
The late fee is late_fee_usd for a minimum payment not paid in full, at most one per due date and never more than that minimum payment.
a returned-payment fee of returned_payment_fee_usd, never more than the minimum payment due, is charged once per returned payment whose return code is in fee_bearing_return_codes.
